description: Integration fixture for scripts/run_e2e.sh and core/tests/test_e2e_wired_md.py: drives the real tevnnis-md binary (not MockMarketDataSource-through-MockMarketDataClient) over a live gRPC connection into core. One MEDIUM news item and one HIGH quote move. tevnnis-md ingests its whole scenario before it starts serving gRPC (see md/src/main.cpp: source.run(...) completes before builder.BuildAndStart()), so core's first PullDecisionBatch sees both events in one round -- the second round then sees nothing new. Do not add a third event, or change these two, without re-checking that assumption against core/tests/test_e2e_wired_md.py and core/scripts/assert_e2e_db.py, which both assert exactly 2 decisions (one OK, one HOLD_NO_EVENTS).
